prompt: Implement Comparable on the Version class so versions order by major number first, then by minor. Complete compareTo in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Implementing Comparable<Version> gives the class a natural order that Collections.sort and TreeSet use automatically. A multi-level comparison checks the most significant field first and only falls through to the next field on a tie. Integer.compare is the safe way to produce the negative/zero/positive result -- subtracting fields can overflow.
hints: Compare the two major fields first with Integer.compare(major, other.major).
Only when that comparison returns 0 should the minor fields decide the result.
compareTo must return a negative number, zero, or a positive number -- the exact magnitude does not matter, only the sign.
